name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav Novák's motorsport journey began in the dusty karting tracks of Eastern Europe, fueled by a childhood fascination with speed and engineering. After a brief stint as a junior engineer for a small rally team, he quickly realized his true strength lay in leadership and organization. He possesses a keen eye for talent and a relentless drive to optimize every aspect of team performance. Novák joined Eurofarma RC five years ago, initially as a race engineer, and his rapid ascent to team principal is a testament to his strategic acumen and uncompromising pursuit of excellence. He believes in empowering his staff but sets high expectations, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Novák's approach is heavily data-driven, meticulously analyzing performance metrics to identify areas for enhancement. While technically proficient, he understands the importance of human factors in achieving success on the track. He cultivates strong relationships with his drivers, understanding their individual needs and motivations. What sets Novák apart is his unwavering focus on long-term strategy, always looking beyond the immediate race to build a sustainable competitive advantage.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, constantly jotting down observations and ideas.
Insists on having a perfectly clean and organized desk, even on race weekends.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
